entities.summary: Dzina Sazanavets is a weightlifter representing Belarus. She was placed fourth at the 2012 Summer Olympics at the women's 69 kg event, just after her country-mate Maryna Shkermankova. In October 2016, the IOC disqualified her from the 2012 Olympics and annulled her result after her Olympic doping sample was retested and failed.
